descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 Our client is a world-leading reinsurance and risk management company, delivering comprehensive solutions across insurance, underwriting, and data-driven risk assessment. With a strong focus on innovation and long-term stability, they support clients in addressing complex risks and driving sustainable value in an ever-changing global landscape.
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with a strong focus on SQL, data modelling, and Azure-based data solutions. Around 80% of the role will be focused on SQL-related activities, while Databricks experience is considered a plus and can be developed over time. The role is ideal for someone with a strong SQL and data warehousing background who wants to further develop their expertise within the Azure data ecosystem. If this sounds like the right next step for you, hit Apply and let’s start the conversation!
 What You'll Be Doing
Design and develop robust data solutions with a strong focus on SQL and T-SQL
Develop, optimize, and maintain complex queries, data models, and database structures
Create solution designs for new features and translate them into technical User Stories
Drive technical refinements together with Requirement Engineers and Product Owners
Design and maintain data models for data warehouse and transactional environments
Develop and optimize ETL processes and data pipelines using Azure technologies
Work with Microsoft SQL Server and Azure-based data infrastructure
Perform schema and data migrations
Analyze and optimize ETL and database performance
Conduct technical QA and ensure reliable, maintainable data solutions
Support planning activities and collaborate with development teams in an Agile environment
Apply DevOps and CI/CD practices using Azure DevOps and Git
 What You'll Bring Along
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred
At least 5 years of experience in Data Engineering or a comparable role 
Strong hands-on experience with SQL, T-SQL, and Microsoft SQL Server 
Strong knowledge of data modelling, including data warehouse and transactional concepts
Experience designing, developing, and optimizing ETL processes and complex data flows
Good knowledge of the Azure data engineering stack, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, and Cosmos DB
Experience with schema and data migrations
Working knowledge of Python and PowerShell
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, testing, and CI/CD practices
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to independently design technical solutions and translate requirements into technical deliverables
Experience working in Scrum / Agile environments
Excellent command of both spoken and written English
 Nice to Have
Experience with Databricks and Delta Lake – not mandatory; these skills can be developed as part of the role
Experience with Power BI
Experience with performance optimization of large-scale data environments
